observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: dance studio with light wood floors, white walls, and a large mirror wall in the background
observation.formation_and_space: horizontal line facing the front mirror, performing synchronized choreography in place and turning
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: step-touches, side steps, and rhythmic weight shifts coordinated with the beat; exact foot placement occluded by camera distance
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move dynamically, extending outwards, placing hands on hips, or raising overhead with fluid gestures
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle hip sways and rhythmic movement corresponding to the step weight shifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level with occasional quarter and half turns to change facing walls
observation.costume_and_props: matching black long-sleeved tops, short skirts (some white, some yellow with fringe), yellow flowers in hair, and heeled dance shoes
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and weight transfer details are obscured by video resolution and distance

signature_moments.what: dancers raise one arm overhead with a styled hand gesture while swaying hips and stepping side to side
dancers extend arms horizontally to the sides and step rhythmically
dancers step and point with arms framing the face before opening outward
dancers extend both arms wide while stepping across with a slight hip twist
